messages:
Amina (People Ops): Quick ping 12 12 endgame handoff plan for the review close next Tue. We have five reviewer conflicts + two late evidence requests. Please confirm your team backups and flag any reviewers who need comp-time for after-hours reviews.
Carter (ENG Manager): Thx. One of mine is on a travel day and can't access Lattice for signatures. Can we allow manager-signed attestations via email for that day?
Amina (People Ops): Yes. Emergency process: manager-can-sign-email. Please paste the attestation email into the review comment and tag me. We'll accept it only for documented travel/LOA days.
Lina (HRBP): Reminder: if a reviewer is asked to do more than 2 extra reviews outside their org, we need approval from HR for workload and comp-time. Flag here and we'll approve in bulk.
Devin (SRE): We're expecting a paging incident Monday night (possible). Can on-call reviewers get an automatic 24-hr extension?
Amina (People Ops): On-call extension policy applies: 24-hour auto-extension if incident > 2 hours and reviewer was involved. Add comment `on-call extension: incident <incident-ID>` and we'll extend deadline for that review only.
Nina (Recruiting): FYI I can move candidate interviews out of 13:00-16:00 PT window on Mon/Tue if that helps reviewers who need to finish forms. DM me team+names.
Carter (ENG Manager): Two follow-ups: 1) If backup reviewer changes rating materially, do we run a calibration exception? 2) Can backups access manager evidence docs?
Amina (People Ops): 1) If rating changes by more than one band (e.g., 3 -> 1), flag a calibration exception with a quick rationale. We'll schedule rapid calibration. 2) Backups should have view access; if not, DM me `grant-temp` with Lattice handle and I'll enable.
Lina (HRBP): Also note: we need to redact any PII from evidence uploads before sharing with backups in other regions. Use the quick-redaction checklist in the shared folder.
Devin (SRE): Understood. One reviewer is on a short-term security clearance check; they can't see certain docs. Can we mark `restricted` on reviews so only people with clearance see them?
Amina (People Ops): Yes. Use tag: `restricted: clearance-needed`. Backups without clearance can be assigned but must be given redacted evidence and told to mark comments `redacted-review` so calibrators see context.
Carter (ENG Manager): Putting backups in now. Also: can managers mark reviewers as "comp-time eligible" so People Ops can auto-approve compensatory time?
Amina (People Ops): We'll accept `comp-time-eligible` in the review comment and will do a single weekly approval run. Please include hours estimate.
review-bot: Reminder: "Final reviewer handoff + evidence redaction" scheduled in 18 hours. :bell:
Nina (Recruiting): I've blocked candidate windows Mon 14:00-16:00 PT and Tue 09:00-11:00 PT for teams that needed it. Ping me with conflicts.
Lina (HRBP): One last note03 please ensure backups add one concise sentence rationale when they finalize so calibration packet is clear.
Amina (People Ops): Thanks all 64f I'll compile the exception list after EOD and post the calibration addendum. If anything changes after the bot reminder, DM me and cc people-ops@redwood.com.
